orig.il: And it came to pass after
them: and they continued a season
on me when it shall be well

orig.gloss: and/ you will bring to remembrance/ me
orig.il: I pray thee, unto me, and make mention

orig.gloss: and/ you will bring out/ me

orig.il: For indeed I was stolen away
and here also have I done
from off thee, and shall hang
And it came to pass the third
